machine_validation.value: All selected fixture units and the final published artifacts must pass common validation and independent-reader checks; check a separate TM-reuse run.
machine_validation.rationale: The pipeline publishes complete validated output; the independent reader checks the artifact.
machine_validation.impact: Any failing, missing or unstarted unit, artifact or run cannot establish acceptance.

mistranslation.value: No reviewed translation materially changes a subject, action, negation, number or condition.
mistranslation.rationale: Human review checks meaning that structural validation cannot establish.
mistranslation.impact: A material change fails the row; insufficient context is hold.

omission.value: No reviewed translation materially omits a proposition, instruction or restriction.
omission.rationale: Structural validation cannot establish semantic completeness.
omission.impact: A material omission fails the row; insufficient context is hold.

readability.value: Each nonempty reviewed translation is understandable in context, including the sequence and conditions of long text.
readability.rationale: Users need intelligible Japanese in UI labels, dialogue and passages.
readability.impact: A row that cannot be understood fails; insufficient context is hold. Meaning-preserving stylistic differences are allowed.

terminology.value: For units 8503 and 8504, use 信号灯 for signal lantern and 夜警 for night watch; grammatical variation and word order may vary.
terminology.rationale: Two repeated authored terms allow a consistent, explicit human judgment.
terminology.impact: Another translation or omission of either required term fails that row; terminology is not applicable to other rows.

units.rationale: All 19 BetterKeybinds, 30 MonsterOfTheWeek and 7 authored entries are selected.
units.impact: All 56 fresh output rows are reviewed; synthetic coverage does not establish real-MOD dialogue or large-MOD coverage.

text_bytes.rationale: The 49 MOD entries have 482 decoded UTF-8 bytes and the 7 authored entries have 445.
text_bytes.impact: The total describes the selected source text, not a supported maximum.

artifact_bytes.rationale: The selected original binaries contain 952, 1122 and 1060 bytes respectively.
artifact_bytes.impact: This is a sum of three artifacts; product limits apply to each artifact independently.

duration_seconds.rationale: Candidate ceiling per fresh CUDA fixture mode; v0.22 wrapper reference 17.3824957649922 seconds was a different workload and 60 seconds is an approximately 3.45x manual margin.
duration_seconds.impact: Compare each fresh measurement_wall_seconds independently; shared preparation, oracle build and pair cleanup are recorded separately. v0.23 product E2E is unmeasured; confirm scope and value in #85.

ram_bytes.rationale: Candidate 5 GiB worker RSS high-water per fresh CUDA fixture; v0.22 wrapper reference 3761148 KiB (about 3.587 GiB) gives an approximately 1.39x manual margin.
ram_bytes.impact: Compare each worker measurement.rss_bytes independently, not host RAM or runner/oracle RSS. v0.23 product E2E is unmeasured; confirm in #85.

vram_bytes.rationale: Candidate 3 GiB sampled worker VRAM per fresh CUDA fixture; v0.22 wrapper reference 1838 MiB (about 1.795 GiB) gives an approximately 1.67x manual margin.
vram_bytes.impact: Compare each worker measurement.process_vram_sampled_max_bytes independently; partial or missing samples cannot pass. This is neither continuous peak nor total device VRAM. v0.23 E2E is unmeasured; confirm in #85.
